description: Current AI systems, including those used in high-stakes decision-making, often rely on decades-old statistical techniques rather than modern deep learning methods.

instances.assertion: AI systems, particularly those used for predictive optimization, often rely on decades-old statistical techniques rather than modern machine learning methods.
AI systems, particularly those using self-modifying machine learning, can generate outputs that are unforeseen by their developers.
Current AI systems, including those used in high-stakes decision-making, often rely on decades-old statistical techniques rather than modern deep learning methods.
